body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Synthetic Training Media Laboratory is a apex creation capability. Purpose: produces labeled visual and audio examples for approved research tasks.. Inputs: a defined objective with constraints and acceptance criteria. Outputs: the specified artifact — code, design, analysis, or verified result — plus its evidence package. Constraints: available compute, data, tools, and permissions. Expected behavior: the capability either produces a verified result or reports exactly what is missing. Proposed capabilities and research directions — not claims that these already exist or can all be achieved with current technology. 'Boundless' means the catalog and its combinations can keep expanding; actual execution still depends on available compute, storage, data, software, permissions, and physical resources.

demo.title: Executable fragment runs: Ranked retrieval fragment
demo.code:
function rankSearch(docs,q){var qs=q.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);if(!qs.length)return [];return docs.map(function(d){var t=d.toLowerCase();var s=qs.reduce(function(a,w){return a+(t.split(w).length-1);},0);return {doc:d,score:s};}).filter(function(x){return x.score>0;}).sort(function(a,b){return b.score-a.score;});}
var r=rankSearch(['apple pie','apple tart','banana'],'apple');J(r);assert(r.length===2&&r[0].score>=r[1].score,'rank');
